messages:
Alex Chen: FYI NovoMed asked for a temporary embedding retention change in our DPA. They want vectors retained for 7 days (we default to 24h) to run nightly quality checks. Can CS + Security + Legal outline the exact artefacts we need and a single upload location so I can gather everything at once?

Priya Patel: Thanks Alex. My initial checklist idea:
- signed addendum (PDF) with exact scope text
- redacted sample of embeddings (ndjson)
- infra proof: S3 lifecycle policy + bucket ACLs
- short access log extract showing only service principals touched the files
- dataflow diagram showing ephemeral KV cache and no downstream storage
- statement from customer saying embeddings are non-personal data

Marco Rivera: Security here. We can consider 7 days conditionally. Required evidence: hashed/pseudonymized confirmation (or an approved PII review), S3 lifecycle enforcing 7d delete, audit logs for access, and IAM principal extract (script output, <= 15 lines). We also need to document which SOC2 control this touches (retention/disposal). If customer claims vectors are non-PII, we'll still run an entropy + nearest-neighbor check against a small safe corpus.

Ella Thompson: Legal: I'll draft an addendum template with the following scope language suggestion: "Redwood shall retain embeddings generated by Customer for up to seven (7) days solely for bona fide model evaluation and quality assurance purposes; such embeddings shall not be used for profiling or attribution of natural persons." We need the customer's legal entity name and signatory. If they classify embeddings as personal data, we will not grant the exception. Upload the signed PDF before we approve configuration changes.

Alex Chen: PoC is Maya Lin <maya@novomed.com>. She's willing to sign and send a redacted sample. I'll ask for the sample and signature by COB Wednesday.

Priya Patel: Proposed canonical upload path for CS Ops batch (please confirm):
```
/evidence/novomed/dpa-embeddings-exception/
  - novomed_signed_addendum.pdf
  - novomed_redacted_embeddings.ndjson
  - s3_lifecycle_policy.json
  - access_log_excerpt.txt
  - dataflow_diagram.pdf
  - iam_principals_extract.txt
```
If Ops can't write there, we'll share a one-time pre-signed upload link.

Marco Rivera: That path is fine. Security requires the lifecycle policy file and an explicit statement that the bucket is private. We'll perform the quick checks once files are posted: entropy scan, NN-similarity on the sample, and verify IAM principals. I'll leave a checklist item in the verification ticket.

Ella Thompson: I'll put the draft addendum in this thread in the next 45m. Legal will not sign off without the signed customer doc and the dataflow diagram. Also: include a contact for billing/PO so we can tie to contract if needed.

cs-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: upload deadline 2027-04-02 17:00 UTC. Use `/upload-batch evidence/novomed/dpa-embeddings-exception/` to notify Ops when complete.

Alex Chen: I'll request everything and confirm once uploaded. I'll include the customer's statement about non-personal-data in the bundle.

Priya Patel: I'll create a Renewal/AM-facing issue and link the exception so AEs are aware of the retention variance at renewal. Ticket: CS-ONB-9821.

Marco Rivera: If we get the sample early, drop it here and I'll run the quick scripts and paste results (entropy score + top-3 NN distances). If anything implies re-identifiability, we revert to 24h immediately.

Ella Thompson: Agreed. Also flagging for Privacy — if any downstream subprocessors are involved, we might need subprocessor confirmations.

Alex Chen: Understood. I'll update timeline in the ticket. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
thread_text_summary: NovoMed requested a 7-day embeddings retention exception; CS, Security, and Legal outlined required evidence (signed addendum, redacted sample, S3 lifecycle, access logs, dataflow diagram, IAM extract). Legal will draft addendum; Security will run entropy/NN checks; cs-ops-bot set an upload reminder; CS will collect and upload to /evidence/novomed/dpa-embeddings-exception/ by the deadline. Renewal team notified via ticket CS-ONB-9821.
